source_text: Sacerdos exorabit eum ante Dominum, et dimittetur ei. Christus pontifex noster. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Priest will-make-atonement him before Lord, and it-will-be-forgiven to-him. Christ high-priest our. Amen.
pass_b_english: The priest shall [[make atonement for him before the Lord, and it shall be forgiven him >> Bible:Leviticus 6:7]]. Christ is our high priest. Homilia IV CLOSEOUT. Amen.
